name: word-help-balloons
title: Word Help Balloons
description: Dotted-underline terms that open small paper balloons on focus or hover with a definition, arrow and all — real popover semantics (button + role), not a CSS-only mirage, so keyboard users get the same affordance.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Focus Popover: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
